claims.sourceText: Micah Hanks, The Debrief, 'Immaculate Constellation: UAP Bombshell or Disinformation?', 17 October 2024
claims.text: Shellenberger reported the allegations of an alleged US government insider who claims they discovered evidence of an unacknowledged special access program codenamed 'Immaculate Constellation' that has been secretly collecting data on UAP encounters.

edges.label: Hanks published the first general-readership account, 17 October 2024
edges.note: The Debrief's 17 October 2024 piece framed the programme as an open question - 'UAP Bombshell or Disinformation?' - and predates the congressional submission by four weeks.

edges.label: Brought the alleged USAP into the congressional record
edges.note: On 13 November 2024 Shellenberger testified to a House Oversight subcommittee and submitted a twelve-page report, sourced to an alleged insider, describing an unacknowledged special access program collecting UAP data outside acknowledged reporting channels.

b.label: Immaculate Constellation 12-page report entered into the Congressional Record

edges.label: Former AARO director denied the programme's existence
edges.note: Kirkpatrick, who authored Volume I's methodology, publicly denied that Immaculate Constellation exists.

listedOn.label: Immaculate Constellation 12-page report entered into the Congressional Record

title: The Debrief - Immaculate Constellation: UAP Bombshell or Disinformation?
